info.description:
natsmin API plane: manage and monitor NATS systems, JetStream, KV and object stores.

Authenticate with a session cookie (POST /api/v1/auth/login) or an API token sent as `Authorization: Bearer nm_...`.

JetStream stream and consumer configurations use the native NATS JSON format (the same as the `nats` CLI and the $JS.API subjects).
